Analysis: 180 frozen-model external-workload runs.
Unit of pairing: workload seed (six seeds per condition).
Metrics: mean of six per-seed short-flow metrics.
Relative changes: mean of six paired percentage changes.
Positive change means worse FCT than baseline.
Confidence intervals: exploratory paired seed bootstrap,
10,000 resamples, percentile method, two-sided 95%.
These intervals are not multiple-comparison adjusted.
With only six seeds, uncertainty estimates are limited.
P95/P99 are averaged across run-level quantiles;
they are not quantiles of pooled flow completions.
The offered-load percentages are nominal, not
measurements of actual bottleneck utilization.
